LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String, barcode: String): Boolean

Requirement:
Definition: librarian scans a user ID and a book barcode to process a borrowing request.
    Precondition: The system first checks whether the user exists, is not suspended, and still has borrowing quota.
    Postcondition:Then it confirms the selected copy is available (or reserved for this same user), creates a new loan record, sets the due date by user type, updates book status to loaned, and returns true when the checkout succeeds.

context LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String, barcode: String): Boolean
pre:
    User.allInstances()->exists(u |
        u.UserID = uid and
        u.BorrowStatus <> BorrowStatus::SUSPEND and
        u.LoanedNumber < 5
    ) and
    BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(c |
        c.Barcode = barcode and
        (c.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or
         (c.IsReserved = true and
          Reserve.allInstances()->exists(r |
              r.ReservedCopy = c and
              r.ReservedUser.UserID = uid and
              r.IsReserveClosed = false
          )
         )
        )
    )
post:
    if result = true then
        let u : User = User.allInstances()->any(x | x.UserID = uid),
            c : BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(x | x.Barcode = barcode),
            newLoan : Loan = Loan.allInstances()->any(l |
                l.oclIsNew() and
                l.LoanedUser = u and
                l.LoanedCopy = c and
                l.IsReturned = false
            )
        in
            Loan.allInstances()->exists(l |
                l.oclIsNew() and
                l = newLoan and
                l.LoanedUser = u and
                l.LoanedCopy = c and
                l.IsReturned = false and
                l.RenewedTimes = 0
            ) and
            u.LoanedBook->includes(newLoan) and
            c.LoanedRecord->includes(newLoan) and
            u.LoanedNumber = u.LoanedNumber@pre + 1 and
            c.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
            ((c.IsReserved@pre = true and

                  r.ReservedUser = u and
                  r.IsReserveClosed = false
              )

            (u.oclIsTypeOf(Student) implies newLoan.DueDate > newLoan.LoanDate) and
            (u.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) implies newLoan.DueDate > newLoan.LoanDate)
    else
        false
    endif
